questions.title: Most American Viticultural Areas
questions.current_disclaimer: AVAs that span state lines are counted for each state they touch, so totals sum to more than the 279 recognized AVAs.

questions.title: Most National Historic Trails
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts each trail once per state it enters. National Scenic Trails (Appalachian Trail, Pacific Crest Trail, etc.) are a separate program and are not included here.

questions.title: Most Rodeos
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts notable annual rodeos listed on Wikipedia; not every county-fair rodeo is included.

questions.title: Most Music Festivals
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts festivals listed by Wikipedia as recurring notable events, past and present.

questions.title: Most Convention Centers
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts all convention and civic exhibition venues listed on the Wikipedia page, including smaller regional facilities as well as major convention halls.

questions.title: Largest State Fair by Attendance
questions.current_disclaimer: Values reflect the single largest state fair in each state as reported on Wikipedia, not the sum of multiple regional fairs. Attendance years vary because state fairs report at different times.

questions.title: Most National Scenic Trails
questions.current_disclaimer: National Historic Trails are administered separately and are not counted here. Each trail counts once per state it enters.

questions.title: Most-Visited Single National Park by State
questions.current_disclaimer: Only units carrying the 'National Park' designation are considered — national monuments, seashores, historic sites, and recreation areas are excluded. Parks spanning two states are credited to each state; the value shown is that state's single busiest park.

questions.title: Most National Wildlife Refuges
questions.current_disclaimer: Refuges whose boundaries cross state lines are counted in the state where the main visitor entrance is located, per the source's convention.

questions.title: Most Amusement Parks
questions.current_disclaimer: Wikipedia's list uses a broad definition that includes regional parks, kiddie parks, family entertainment centers, and some seasonal parks. Central Florida's parks are counted from a linked sub-list.

questions.title: Most National Monuments
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts monuments administered by all federal agencies (NPS, BLM, USFS, USFWS, etc.), not just the National Park Service. Monuments that span two states are counted in each.

questions.title: Most National Scenic Byways
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts every state a byway passes through, so byways spanning multiple states are credited to each. Hawaii and Texas have no designated byways.

questions.title: Most Lighthouses
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts all lighthouses identified by the US Coast Guard on each state's Wikipedia list, including active, deactivated, destroyed, and historic structures.
